{{Quote|I heard that Hyrol Preen Beta was a Rebel base; that was why the Imps came down so hard on the natives. They couldn't catch the Rebels so they made it impossible to stick around.|Johin|<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" />}}
The '''pacification of Hyrol Preen Beta''' was an event<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" /> that resulted in the destruction of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hyrol Preen Beta]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CSWE" /> According to the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Johin]], the Empire came down hard on the natives<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" /> due to suspected Rebel activity,<ref name="CSWE" /> as the planet was rumored to have been a base for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" /> When it could not catch them outright,<ref name="CSWE" /> a combination of the "[[DeathWhispers]]" [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]] unit, their [[ZQ Infantry Support Unit]]s, and regular line [[Trooper/Legends|troops]]<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology" /> wiped out Hyrol Preen Beta' [[City/Legends|settlements]] in order to prevent the Rebels from returning.<ref name="CSWE" />
